data.title: Step 6: fix, log, *hand over*
data.subtitle: Step 6 of 6 in the self-check loop.

items: Fix only failed tests and fair attacks
Get a change log: what, and why
Get a list of what you must check
Ask what it did with tools, and what it only described

blocks.text: Fix only what failed. Then give me a change log, and a list of what I must still check myself.
**You'll get back:** the new version, a change log and your own checklist.
Use it last. Then do your own check.

items: Confirm anything it says it sent or made

blocks.text: Anthropic: never your only source of truth.
